description: WP-A long radial run: death or T, whichever first. frac = E(r<3hw)/E0. T_90, T_death as in SESSION_02_PREDICTIONS Block 1; osc_* = T omega_settled/(2 pi); periods_counted_* = upward zero crossings of phi(0,t) (Schmitt trigger). E_in quadrature error ~1e-4 of E at dr = 0.05 (F-003).

params.initial_data: phi = Phi(r) single-frequency profile (solve_profile tol 1e-10) / sqrt(g4), phi_t = 0
params.scheme: u=r phi, 4th-order FD, odd reflection at r=0 and r=R_box, RK4

energy_check.note: E_h (exactly conserved without sponge) may only fall with the sponge on
